title: Promotion and rowmotion in rational Catalan combinatorics
summary: We study four bijections, which are promotion, evacuation, rowmotion, and rowvacuation, on generalized Dyck paths in rational Catalan combinatorics. We define the maps on generalized Dyck paths, which have their origins in maps on Dyck paths and non-crossing partitions. They include rotation, Kreweras complement map, Simion--Ullman involution on non-crossing partitions, and Lalanne--Kreweras involution on Dyck paths.
